release_notes:
- Added "Upload File" button in Bluetooth tab to load power table from .htf or .txt files
- Core Dump output folder now remembers recent directories (history dropdown)
- Added new "Download Power Table" button in the Bluetooth tab
- Fixed a logging issue that caused log entries to be missing or incorrectly formatted
- Added new DMC tab for reading and writing DMC group configuration (CUSTOMER5, CUSTOMER6, CUSTOMER7 PS keys)
